name: ifthenpay | Payments for LatePoint
author: ifthenpay

sections.description:
ifthenpay for LatePoint lets you add your personal ifthenpay credentials (Backoffice Key & Gateway Key) and instantly offer multiple payment options in your appointment checkout:

  • PIX (Brazil)
  • MB WAY (Portugal)
  • Bizum (Spain)
  • Multibanco & Payshop vouchers (Portugal)
  • Credit Cards (Visa, MasterCard)
  • Google Pay & Apple Pay
  • Invoices (Orders & Invoices support)

Setup is quick—enter your ifthenpay credentials, sync your account, choose the methods you want, and you’re live.

Requirements

  • An active ifthenpay merchant account — subscribe at https://ifthenpay.com/aderir/ to obtain your credentials.
  • LatePoint appointment-booking plugin installed and activated.
  • WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 7.4+.

External Services & Dependencies

  • LatePoint (appointment-booking plugin): we extend its framework classes (OsFormHelper, OsSettingsHelper, etc.).
  • ifthenpay API:
    • Sends your private credentials (Backoffice Key & Gateway Key) to validate your account and list available methods.
    • Sends payment tokens/IDs and minimal order details (amount, success/cancel URLs) to create “pay-by-link” transactions or invoice payments, and to verify payment status.

No other user or site data is transmitted.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for ifthenpay | Payments for LatePoint, then click Install Now.
  2. Or download ifthenpay-payments-for-latepoint.zip and upload under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate LatePoint and ifthenpay for LatePoint.
  4. Navigate to LatePoint → Settings → Payments, enter your ifthenpay Backoffice Key & Gateway Key, and click Connect.
sections.faq:
What do I need to get started?

  • A valid ifthenpay account (register at https://ifthenpay.com/aderir/)
  • LatePoint plugin active
  • WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 7.4+

How do I configure it?

  1. Go to LatePoint → Settings → Payments.
  2. Enable the ifthenpay gateway, enter your Backoffice Key & Gateway Key, click Sync.
  3. Select the payment methods (including invoices) you want to offer.
